bias.zh: 转弱 · 跌破 200 日均线

read.en: Corning fell 6% on Oct 12 to $147.28 and is now below all its averages: the 200-day ($152.6), 30-day ($155), 5 and 10-day ($158–159) and 100-day ($169). MACD crossed below its signal and Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on the day; RSI is 44. The $152–155 support band from the last read has given way.
read.zh: 康宁 10月12日下跌 6%，收于 $147.28，已跌破全部均线：200 日（$152.6）、30 日（$155）、5 日和 10 日（$158–159）以及 100 日（$169）。MACD 当日下穿信号线，抛物线 SAR 同日转空；RSI 为 44。上次解读中的 $152–155 支撑区已失守。

read.en: Next support is the mid-September lows at $142–144, then $139 (Sep 3 low); below that there is little until $114.50 (Jul 28 low). The broken 200-day average at $152.6 and the 30-day at $155 are now resistance, with the 5 and 10-day averages near $159 above.
read.zh: 下一支撑为 9月中旬低点 $142–144，其次 $139（9月3日低点）；再往下直到 $114.50（7月28日低点）都缺乏支撑。已跌破的 $152.6（200 日均线）和 $155（30 日均线）转为阻力，其上为约 $159 的 5 日和 10 日均线。
